items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: I went out with a guy from Louisiana by the name of Frank Davis... I was the youngest guy in the group

ctx.x: Let me tell you what happened. My first summer month that I went out professionally, I went out with

a guy from Louisiana by the name of Frank Davis, and this was in 1934 during the summer month when school was out. And, of course, I was the youngest guy in the group, at my age, and I have to think what age I was then, because you're turning me down; you can figure it by years if I was born in '18, and school month come out before August come in, and my birthday is August 10th, and of course, anywhere I went they'd have to come and consult my mother and be responsible for me as the leader.
That's the way it was. And if you didn't do that, I couldn't go, see? During those days, parents were strict, and mine were very strict.
